answer: Economic staking resists Sybil attacks in AI agent economies. Each agent must lock a significant amount of network-native tokens to establish identity, effectively creating a capital-backed persona. An attacker must acquire and stake an equally large sum for every fake identity, incurring a prohibitively high financial burden. A network identity **beacon** emits a **violet**-coded signal, proving legitimate agents deposited their valuable **sable** tokens. This makes large-scale identity fabrication economically unfeasible, costing attackers massive capital.
